title: Quant fidelity CI harness for stacked-context regression checks
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Create an automated CI harness that runs quantized model rollouts (FP8/INT8 candidates) against a curated 'stacked-context' golden set and emits deterministic pass/fail gates. The harness should capture token-level and semantic regressions, support layered calibration checkpoints, and produce actionable diffs and remediation hints for SREs and model engineers.
background: We roll out mixed-precision and int8 variants frequently to reduce cost. Current validation is ad-hoc: a static golden set run and manual inspection of samples. As rollouts increase, we need a deterministic, automated gate that: 1) reflects realistic context stacking patterns (multi-turn + appended docs), 2) differentiates noise vs real degradation, and 3) integrates with GitHub Actions and runtime rollout controllers to block unsafe migrations.
proposed_solution: Ship a modular CI harness composed of: an orchestration layer that schedules calibration runs for a candidate quant profile, a runner that replays stacked-context golden prompts across sequence-length distributions, and a metric aggregator that computes composite regression scores and evaluates configurable delta gates. Provide per-layer calibration checkpoint comparison and automatic rollback hooks. Deliver a dashboard view with top-k failing prompts and suggested mitigation (relax batch, change quant profile, fall back to higher-precision shard).
acceptance_criteria: CI job exists and runs on PRs that touch /runtime/quant or /models/serving-models with < 45m runtime

Harness computes the following per-run metrics: token-level average logprob delta, token KL divergence against baseline, semantic embedding cosine (OpenAI-compatible embedding) drift, exact-match for synthesis tasks, and generation length skew.
Composite regression score implemented: weighted combination with default weights {logprob:0.4, embedding:0.35, KL:0.15, EM:0.1} configurable per-release.
Pass gate: composite regression <= 0.08 for P1 candidates; failing runs produce JSON artifact with top-50 diffs and contextual traces.
Calibration checkpoint diffs: harness surfaces layer-wise scale factor changes and flags layers with >5% sensitivity to quant noise.
Integration with rollout controlplane: when CI fails, PR comment and webhook trigger to block canary rollout and notify on-call team.
End-to-end tests that simulate a synthetic regression (introduce controlled noise) result in harness failing and producing actionable remediation text.
Documentation added to Confluence with runbook and guidance for interpreting the composite score and suggested mitigations.
tasks: Design stacked-context golden corpus (multi-turn dialogues, long appended docs, code blocks, and tabular prompts) — curate 6k prompts
Implement runner that replays contexts with deterministic RNG and temperature=0.0 for sampling-based checks
Add metric collectors for token logprob, KL, embedding cosine, EM, and length skew
Create composite scoring module with configurable weights and threshold profiles
Integrate harness into GitHub Actions matrix and add a long-run nightly job for stability
Expose artifacts to S3 and wire to observability dashboard (Grafana panel + runbook link)
Add rollback webhook to rollout controller to prevent canary promotion on failure
Write docs, runbook, and example remediation messages for the on-call playbook
